data.title: A new journal answers nothing: what does the first day show?
data.description: Every example on the new page needs a journal with weeks in it. A reviewer who installs today gets an empty prime and a silent hook, so the first thing they learn is that it does nothing. The decisions most teams already have are elsewhere: ADR folders, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, PR descriptions. Question for the owner: should init offer to bring some of them in, and from where, without guessing at what is a decision?
